answer_1.quote: We evaluate DrDiff on the LongBench, which encompasses a variety of challenging tasks, including single-document question answering, multidocument question answering, long in-context learning, long dialogue, code repository analysis, and long structured data processing.
answer_1.outputs: Long-form generated texts, summaries, answers to QA, dialogues

answer_2.quote: We assess model performance using BLEU, ROUGE-L, and BERTScore for text quality, and report accuracy and F1 scores on tasks such as WikiHop and TriviaQA.
